evidence.description: Observations that decide this criterion's status, each with a file:line or command. For FAIL, list the failing observations first. Confirmations belong here, not in findings.

findings.description: Defects only: each one reproducible mismatch or failure with its location. Never a confirmation or a summary that something checks out; an empty array means no defect was found.

unknowns.description: What could not be established and why, including anything outside the inspected scope.
